verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a compile-and-reflect workflow for C++ gameplay classes (recompile in VS/XCode, then changes appear in the Editor) and Blueprint visual scripting for designer-level changes, which together form Unreal's edit-run loop, but no evidence explicitly documents 'hot reload' or 'near-instant' iteration times, and one community comment notes full engine/art builds can take 24-36 hours. Missing for 10: explicit hot-reload/Live Coding feature documentation, benchmarked iteration times, and hands-on confirmation that Blueprint/C++ changes appear near-instantly rather than requiring full recompiles.
